correctness.rationale: From the full centralizer module description, nilpotence forces precisely two zero diagonal constants and leaves 4n-4 free scalars. Britnell-Wildon Proposition 4.7 filtration gives the exact H invertible and (H^n)11=0 criterion; 4n-8 remaining scalars are free. Every nonscalar 2x2 matrix and its nonscalar nth power have equal two-dimensional commutants, so powering maps their similarity classes bijectively. A nonscalar invertible class contains exactly q-1 representatives with zero top-left entry. Counting Jordan, split semisimple and irreducible quadratic classes yields (q-1)(q-(gcd(n,q-1)+gcd(n,q+1))/2+1_{p does not divide n}) classes. The 40 exact 2x2 cases and full centralizer checks (n,q)=(3,2),(3,3),(4,2) pass. Finite tests do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The known field-dependent existence obstruction is sharpened to an exact, positive/zero and quantitative density law. The two independent gcd terms reveal how multiplicative group orders q-1 and q+1 jointly control frequency, which is not determined by the old yes/no criterion. The result supplies a precise fiber cardinality for natural two-block nilpotent commuting pairs and is directly usable in weighted counts and random centralizer sampling.
